<div class="card-body">
'''Furry Fury''' is a [[Dark]] [[Interrupt]] ([[Used or Lost Interrupt]]) from [[Hoth (Japanese)|Hoth (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">毛むくじゃら、おかんむり</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">ユーズド：「ウーキーの雄叫び」、「ハンの帰還」、「命の借り」のいずれかをキャンセルする。

ロスト：ハンとチューイーが一緒に参加している時に使用する。運命数を２枚引く。合計値を、敵による損耗と合計戦闘力の値から引く（最低でも０より下には下がらない）。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Hoth-Furry-Fury-PSA-151452824.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">「わかったよ、そう怒るな」 ウーキーの怒りはホスの大地を揺るがす。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Hairy and in a temper.

'''Card text:'''
USED: Cancel Wookiee Roar, Han's Back or Life Debt.

LOST: Use when Han and Chewie are taking part together. Draw two destiny. Subtract the total from opponent's attrition and total power (cannot fall below zero).

'''Lore:'''
"All right, don't get so angry." A Wookiee's rage shakes the ground of Hoth.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Furry Fury]] in [[Hoth (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 43, 103. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
